name: mycomparemaster
description: My Compare Master — cross-platform file, directory and 3-way merge tool (Tauri desktop app + web) that also works as a git difftool/mergetool
author: SHKWON <knix008@naver.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:server
scripts.build:desktop: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build && npm run installer
scripts.build:win: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build --bundles nsis && npm run installer
scripts.build:mac: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build --bundles dmg && npm run installer
scripts.build:linux: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build --bundles appimage,deb && npm run installer
